title: Fragments on the Twelve Gems
author: Epiphanius of Salamis
blurb: Fragments on the twelve gems of the high priest's breastplate, and what each one means.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Epiphanius of Salamis’s De xii gemmis Fragmenta — new OET from PG 41–43 Greek (Khazarzar). Modern English syncs (incl. Pusey-PD / Greystone / Lunn / Hill) were not used as wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew densify. SERIES CLOSEOUT.
